messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2654321999 - Elevated 5xx rate and gateway timeouts observed across API gateway in us-west-2. 5xx spike started ~5m ago, 429s increasing. Paging oncall: @eric (oncall) :phone:
eric (oncall): I'm on it. seeing alert graphs in Ops -> Service -> gateway-proxy. 5xx from `gateway` and `route-proxy` primarily. 429s jumped after 2m. any deploys?
maya (sre): I can pull logs. tag me with spans. Looks like many upstreams returning 502/504 and the gateway is also hitting rate-limit responses when retries spike.
lee (eng-runtime): I rolled out quota policy PR #4823 ten mins ago that tightened global token-per-sec limits for non-paid tenants. Could be related. Reverting now if needed.
julie (prod-support): CS already seeing chat logs about timeouts from multiple customers in west region. Ana, can you surface top impacted customers?
ana (cs): FYI: three mid-market customers reported segfault-like errors in their apps ~4-6m ago. I'm drafting an incident banner.
eric (oncall): Quick triage — is this a capacity/backpressure cascade (retries->queue->5xx) or quota misapply causing 429s which cascade into 5xx? Graphs: request latency up, retry count up, gateway 429->upstream 502.
maya (sre): Replaying logs: many 429 responses originate from `quota-enforcer` returning global throttle to ~50rps for some routes after the PR. When clients retry, they flood other paths and some model endpoints start timing out -> 504. So looks like quota misconfiguration causing cascading failures.
lee (eng-runtime): Confirmed. PR #4823 changed default global limit from 1000rps -> 50rps for `/v1/generate` for unknown tenants. My bad, I scoped the change incorrectly. Rolling that PR back now.
deploy-bot: rollback started for commit 3efa2b7 (reverting quota-change). ETA ~90s.
julie (prod-support): Posting to status page: "We are investigating increased errors and timeouts in us-west-2. Some customers may see 5xx/429. Updates soon."
eric (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) stop the rollback if rollback takes too long, 2) temporary unblock: bump global limit to safe value, 3) enable circuit-breaker to avoid retries amplifying failures, 4) route traffic away from impacted model instances if possible. Maya, can you change the running quota config?
maya (sre): I can patch the running config in confd: `global.rate_limit.v1_generate = 1000` and set `throttle_behavior=fail_fast` to reduce retries. Patching now.
maya (sre): Patch applied. Confirming via `curl -s http://config-api/local/global | jq .rate_limit.v1_generate` -> `1000`.
eric (oncall): Nice. Now adjust retry plug-in to backoff and cap at 1 retry to avoid flood.
lee (eng-runtime): Pushing a lightweight config to the gateway: `retry.max_attempts=1` and `retry.backoff=200ms` for the next 15m.
maya (sre): Also enabling circuit-breaker on model endpoints: `cb.open_threshold=5%` to trip earlier.
ops-kai: I see a traffic shift after the patch, 5xx rate is dropping, 429s decreasing. Rolling average exhibit downtrend over last 60s.
eric (oncall): Good. Julie, coordinate customer comms: impacted list + ETA for next update in 15m.
julie (prod-support): On it. Sending proactive emails to top 5 impacted accounts and adding status page update.
ana (cs): Customers acknowledged. No P0 support tickets yet, but one engineering contact requested an incident postmortem.
lee (eng-runtime): Rollback finished and verified by deploy-bot. system shows config at pre-PR values.
deploy-bot: rollback complete: reverted commit 3efa2b7.
maya (sre): Metrics look stable for 3 continuous mins. 5xx down to baseline, latency trending back, no spike in queue depth.
eric (oncall): Great. Lessons quickly: 1) avoid changing global default quotas without canary. 2) add preflight to quota PRs that simulates traffic. 3) make quota-change an opt-in per-tenant flag.
lee (eng-runtime): I'll open follow-up tasks and a revert-proof gating: require two approvers + staging canary for quota rules.
julie (prod-support): CS: need template for "quota changes caused transient errors" to speed messaging.
a na (cs): scheduling customer follow-ups for tomorrow.
eric (oncall): Handoff — @maya (sre) will remain shadow for next 30m, then hand to @ops-kai for overnight. Please record any residual anomalies.
maya (sre): ack. I'll also capture the traces for the postmortem and collect request IDs: `grep -E "quota-enforcer.*429|gateway.*504" /var/log/gateway/*.log | head -n 200`
lee (eng-runtime): I'll create PR with canary test + stricter lint for quota config. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4890
eric (oncall): Assigning P0 to this thread until EOD: runbook tasks: - confirm long tail errors cleared - compile timeline - identify root cause (mis-scoped PR) - customer impact list - postmortem owner.
julie (prod-support): I'm adding incident banner: "Services are recovering; we identified a quota config change as likely cause. A full postmortem will follow."
an a (cs): Noted. Key customers asked for estimated downtime windows; giving them the 15m recovery window.
ops-kai: Taking over monitoring. If anything flares, please @pager oncall.
eric (oncall): Closing active mitigation. Update last: rollback + runtime patch succeeded. Will open postmortem ticket and schedule RCA. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
maya (sre): Postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8721. I'll add logs/traces.
lee (eng-runtime): Also adding automated simulation to CI that validates quota knobs won't drop below N per-route.
julie (prod-support): Final status post: "Incident mitigated. Some customers experienced transient 429/5xx between T0 and T0+10m. No data loss. Postmortem pending."
eric (oncall): Last message: handoff to @ops-kai at ts 2654322178. If no regressions by EOD, mark resolved.
ops-kai: ack, monitoring. will update if anything shows.
